meta.title: Workspace toolkit
meta.description: All-in-one workspace enhancements: per-workspace models, workspace token usage, custom model providers, and a decorated workspace list (expand/collapse all, pin, note, title color, token chip).

workspace.colorInvalid: Invalid color: use #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(), hsl() or var(--dsw-*)
model.invalid: Fill in both the provider id and the model id
settings.title: Workspace toolkit
settings.desc: Pick a model per workspace and review token usage grouped by workspace.
settings.showSidebar: Show this plugin entry in the left sidebar
settings.showSidebarHint: The page stays reachable from Settings when disabled.
overview.title: Workspace toolkit
overview.desc: Configure a model per workspace (follows the current model by default), review token usage grouped by workspace, and manage pinning, notes and title colors for the left workspace list.
overview.hint: A workspace model only affects new sessions; sessions without an override follow the current model.
providers.title: Custom models
providers.desc: Add any OpenAI / Anthropic compatible custom model (optionally with custom request headers). After saving, pick it in a workspace "Configure model"; the configuration is written into the host pi-ai adapter — the plugin ships no vendors itself.
providers.unavailable: This host does not expose the configEditor service, so custom providers cannot be managed here.
providers.routeHint: Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only; up to 64 characters
providers.routeLocked: Provider ID cannot be changed after saving
providers.baseURLHint: Leave empty to use the adapter default
providers.apiKeyEnvHint: The key is stored in the host credential store; the config only keeps a reference: {name}
providers.saved: Saved. The model catalog refreshes shortly.
providers.deleted: Deleted. The model catalog refreshes shortly.
providers.validationRoute: Enter a valid provider ID (letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens)
providers.validationModels: Add at least one model ID
providers.validationBaseURL: Base URL must start with http:// or https://
